insights:
DeepSeek led the day with a 90% cut to DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, down from $0.733 to $0.074 per 1M tokens, the steepest move on the board. DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 was halved across variants, $2.20 to $1.10, with max and high configurations at $1.27 to $0.640. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (max) also halved to $0.300 and entered the intelligence frontier. The cuts weren't uniform: DeepSeek Flash Latest rose 62% to $0.347, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash edged up 5% to $0.347.

Going the other way, GLM-5.3-Flash jumped 283%, from $0.070 to $0.267, and dropped from #1 clear out of the top 10 and off the frontier. GLM-5.3 (max) also left both. Kimi Latest climbed 49% to $8.16. Cheaper: Z.ai GLM Flash Latest fell 15% to $0.059, Gemma 4 26B A4B dropped 25% to $0.120, and Kimi K3 slipped 9% to $3.76.

New to the list is Kimi K3.1 Pro at intelligence 55.0 and $4.67, a 0.312 deal. Ling-3.0-flash-VL and Mercury 2.5 joined the frontier. Kimi K3 (low) was removed.
